_comment: Delivering the dead god's letter to the Quiet One. The fourth and last.
THE LOCKED SOURCE, the letter, which shipped long before this scene:
SUBJECT: UNRESPONSIVE -- further to previous
'Further to previous. There is no previous on file that has been answered, so the
office is unable to state which previous this is further to.'
'The sun is turned daily. Attendance is recorded. The undersigned continues to
write and has stopped stating why.'
WORLD.md: 'The Quiet One has no name in the letters, and that is the whole character.
Three letters open with a name. The fourth opens `To --`. Whether the dead god never
got close enough to have one, or had one and struck it out, IS NEVER ANSWERED; the
letter itself is the only evidence and it is ambiguous on purpose.'
SO THIS SCENE MUST NOT RESOLVE IT, and that is a hard constraint rather than a
preference. Every other delivery scene gets its god's side of the story. This one
cannot have one, because the moment the Quiet One explains itself the mid-game's best
ambiguity is spent and 'the one who never wrote back' stops being a question about the
DEAD GOD and becomes a fact about this one.
THE GOD DOES NOT SPEAK. Not once. Every `speaker` line here is a description of what
does not happen -- which is the same joke its whole world is built on: the Nether and
the End both refuse a bed LOUDLY, and this world declines to react at all. The scene
is the players, in a silence, deciding what to do about it. That is a genuinely
different shape from the other three rather than a fourth variation, and it is the
only shape this god can have.
THE FOURTH TRANSGRESSION. The others are: take away the Verdant's defence, tell the
Anchorite the job is over, ask the Hearth-Turner to let a record leave. Here it is
SIGNING FOR THE LETTER YOURSELF -- recording a delivery as received when nothing
acknowledged it. Filing a receipt on behalf of somebody who will not speak. It is
perfectly in the mod's procedural register, it is a real intrusion, and nobody should
be able to decide alone that a silence counted as consent. Hence UNANIMOUS.
THE PAYOFF IS MECHANICAL AND UNSTATED. Regard with the Quiet One moves through this
scene exactly as it does in the other three -- and NOTHING IN THE TEXT EVER SAYS SO.
You are treated differently afterwards by something that never told you it noticed.
`tools/delivery_check.sh` asserts the number moved precisely because the scene will
not: it is the one place where a check can see something the player is not shown.
Dread covenant, and it applies hardest here: 'the Quiet One's silence is never cute.'
Nothing in this file winks at the silence, plays it for a gag, or has a character
remark on how quiet it is as a joke. The permitted comedy is the SYSTEM -- an office
that continues to write and has stopped stating why.
